item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: Felony charges filed in Thornton State Beach fence case; new questions about real estate investor
item.description: The owners of the property say that Luke Brugnara has taken advantage of tensions in the family that owns much of the land leading to Thornton State Beach. We've also learned that the transfer of one small slice he got "for free" may not be legal in the first place.

item.title: US and Israel launch joint strike in Iran, US official says
item.description: Israel and the US have launched a joint attack on Iran, officials say. President Trump confirmed the US military began "major combat operations."

item.title: What to know about US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: The attacks came a day after Trump voiced frustration over lack of progress in negotiations to stop Iran's ability to develop nuclear weapons.

item.title: Man convicted in 2012 killing of Sierra LaMar may get a new trial after court ruling
item.description: The man convicted in the 2012 killing of Morgan Hill teen Sierra Lamar may get a new trial. This comes after the California Court of Appeals reversed Antolin Garcia-Torres' judgment on Friday, saying, "There was insufficient evidence of willful, deliberate, and premeditated murder or a specific intent to kill."

item.title: Family of Brentwood mom who died in police custody finally see bodycam footage months after request
item.description: After five months of pressuring the Brentwood Police Department to release body camera footage of the arrest of 72-year-old Yolanda Ramirez, her family finally got to watch a redacted version on Friday.

item.title: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader, is dead, Trump says
item.description: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, 86, the supreme leader of Iran, was killed in the U.S.-Israeli attack on the country Saturday, President Donald Trump said.

item.title: Bay Area Iranian community rallies in response to US-Israel joint strikes
item.description: "Let the people of Iran decide on their own future and destiny." Calls for regime change in Iran came from the streets of Berkeley Saturday in the wake of the U.S.-Israel joint strikes.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Low clouds, fog and cooler temperatures tomorrow morning
item.description: Lows will be in the 50s. Afternoon highs will be close to average in the low to mid-60s with a chance of spotty showers arriving in the evening in the North Bay.

item.title: San Francisco Ballet cancels upcoming performances at Kennedy Center
item.description: The San Francisco Ballet board has voted to cancel its upcoming performances at the Kennedy Center.
